I farm 15 mu here in Quzhou — wheat in winter, maize in summer, and I keep a small piece for cotton because the price can be good some years. My middle school education helps me read fertilizer bags and listen at the agro-station meetings, but mostly I go by what works on my land after 40 years.

Wheat goes on about 8 mu. I plant Jimai improved variety, same as my neighbors. I put down compound fertilizer (15-15-15) at sowing, about 50 jin per mu, that gives me roughly 7-8 kg N, 7-8 P, 7-8 K. Then I top-dress urea at jointing in spring, about 30 jin (15 kg) per mu — that's another 7 kg of N. So total around 15 kg N, 8 P, 8 K. I water 3 times: before winter, at jointing, at grain filling. Spray 2 times — herbicide once, and aphid/powdery mildew once. Plough before sowing. I expect 450-500 kg per mu, last year I got 480.

Maize follows on the same 8 mu. I use Zhengdan or Xianyu hybrid seed. Plant straight after wheat harvest, no-till with the seeder. Compound fertilizer at planting 40 jin (20 kg, so about 3-3-3 of each), then urea side-dress at big trumpet stage 40 jin (20 kg = 9 kg N). Total around 12 kg N, 3 P, 3 K. Water twice if rain is short. Spray once for borer and armyworm. Expect about 550 kg per mu.

Cotton on 7 mu. I use improved Bt cotton seed — saves spray money. Plough in spring, base fertilizer compound 50 jin per mu, then urea twice during boll stage, total maybe 18 kg N, 8 P, 8 K. Water 3 times from well. Spray 4 times — even with Bt I still need to fight aphids and bollworm late. Expect 250 kg lint per mu.
